To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have identified two human antibodies that bind serotypes A and B botulinum neurototoxin and that one of these antibodies is able to neutralize serotype A BoTON in vivo.

1) we cloned a natural human IgM anti-serotype A BoNT antibody that is able to neutralize the neurotoxin in a mouse model of botulism and 2) we found that the antibody repertoire of a single human donor is capable of producing multiple anti-serotype A antibodies, some of which have high affinity for BoNT and neutralize BoNT in vitro.

We describe the cloning of human IgM antibodies from peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) that bind serotype-A botulinum neurotixin (BoNT) and one that is able to fully-neutralize a lethal dose in vivo.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the discovery of antibodies that neutralize botulinum neuro toxin.
the development of antibody-based therapies to treat or prevent exposure to biological toxins, including the botulinum neurooxins.
the development of human monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) as countermeasures against exposure to botulinium neurotoxins (BoNT).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the natural human IgM antibodies described here are the first examples of natural (unmutated) antibodies to BoNT that can neutralize a lethal challenge in a mouse model.
this antibody is able to neutralize the lethal dose of serotypes A and B botulinum neurootoxins in mice and that it is a natural human antibody.

a natural un-mutated antibody was found to have neutralized a lethal dose of botulinum neuro toxin in vivo, and the authors suggest that the natural antibody repertoire may play some role in protection from biological toxins.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the human antibody repertoire is an untapped resource for the discovery and development of biologics.
we have identified a human antibody that neutralizes BoNT in vivo, and that this antibody is un-mutated and likely from a naive B cell.
the natural human IgM antibodies can be used as an effective countermeasure against the botulinum neuro toxin.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are natural antibodies in the human population that neutralize BoNT.
there are natural IgMs that neutralize botulinum toxin and that these antibodies can be used as a starting point for the generation of therapeutic monoclonal antibodies.
natural human antibodies can be effective in neutralizing BoNT in vivo and thus may be important in the protective immune repertoire.
